pending.title: Foreign residents must notify ATO before selling Australian assets over $50m
pending.description: Foreign residents disposing of Australian shares and membership interests exceeding $50m in value must notify the ATO before executing the transaction. Commencement has been deferred until enabling legislation passes Parliament.
pending.suggestion: Add to budget-updates.json: Foreign resident notification requirement with $50m threshold and note that commencement depends on legislation passing.

pending.title: Working Australians Tax Offset: $250 annual relief for workers
pending.description: The Budget introduced an annual tax offset of up to $250 for earned income, providing modest relief for working Australians. This is separate from the CGT and negative gearing changes.
pending.suggestion: Add to budget-updates.json: Working Australians Tax Offset details as a separate measure from investment tax reforms.

pending.title: Venture capital tax incentives to expand from July 2027
pending.description: The Government announced expansion of venture capital tax incentives to align with modern company valuations, offering investors including superannuation funds greater flexibility to invest for longer periods.
pending.suggestion: Add to budget-updates.json: Venture capital tax incentive expansion from 1 July 2027 as part of innovation investment support.

pending.title: How does inflation indexation affect CGT calculation?
pending.description: The 50% CGT discount will be replaced with inflation-based indexation. The Australian Shareholders Association notes this may not address 'income bunching' where gains accumulated over many years are realised in a single tax year, and is calling for an averaging mechanism.
pending.suggestion: Add FAQ: Explain how inflation indexation works for CGT, what it means vs the 50% discount, and mention the potential 'bunching' issue for assets held for long periods.

pending.title: Foreign resident ATO notification deferred until legislation passes
pending.description: The foreign resident $50m notification requirement has no fixed start date — commencement is deferred until the enabling legislation is passed by Parliament.
pending.suggestion: Add to timeline.json: Note that foreign resident notification requirement has no fixed date, contingent on legislation passing.

implemented.title: Division 296 super tax: $3m threshold applies from 1 July 2026
implemented.description: The $3m super balance tax (Division 296) legislation enacted in March 2026 will commence from 1 July 2026, meaning high-balance superannuation accounts will face additional 15% tax on earnings above this threshold.
implemented.suggestion: Add to budget-updates.json: Note that Division 296 legislation was passed in March 2026 and commences 1 July 2026, affecting SMSF and APRA-regulated fund members with balances exceeding $3m.

implemented.title: CGT averaging vs indexation: ASA calls for reform beyond inflation adjustment
implemented.description: The Australian Shareholders Association supports inflation indexation but argues it doesn't address income bunching where long-term gains are realised in one year. ASA is calling for a modern averaging mechanism to be added to CGT reform.
implemented.suggestion: Add to debates.json: ASA's position that CGT reform should include averaging mechanism alongside indexation, creating a debate between government policy and investor advocate recommendations.

implemented.title: Division 296 super tax commences 1 July 2026
implemented.description: The $3m super balance tax (Division 296) officially takes effect from 1 July 2026, earlier than the 1 July 2027 date for CGT/negative gearing changes.
implemented.suggestion: Add to timeline.json: 1 July 2026 entry for Division 296 tax commencement, listing it before the main CGT/negative gearing changes.

implemented.title: Venture capital incentive expansion announced for July 2027
implemented.description: Venture capital tax incentive expansion to align with modern valuations will be introduced from 1 July 2027, the same date as CGT and negative gearing changes.
implemented.suggestion: Add to timeline.json: 1 July 2027 entry noting venture capital incentive expansion alongside CGT/negative gearing changes.

implemented.title: Is inflation indexation more favourable than 50% discount for long-held assets?
implemented.description: The change from 50% discount to inflation indexation requires verification. For assets held for long periods, indexation may result in a larger taxable gain than the current 50% discount, depending on inflation over the holding period. This contradicts assumptions that indexation is always better.
implemented.suggestion: Add to fact-checks.json: Clarify that inflation indexation does not guarantee a lower CGT outcome than the 50% discount. Provide examples showing when each approach is more favourable based on inflation rates and holding period.
